domains.title: 武将の人生と人のつながり
domains.scope: 開始から身分・成長・主従・配下・継承まで、一人の人生を遊ぶ。

domains.title: 領地の暮らしと地域社会
domains.scope: 生産・財政・交易と、村落・国人・寺社との関わりを動かす。

domains.title: 軍勢と支配の変動
domains.scope: 軍事行動、城の支配、独立や家督による勢力の変化をつなぐ。

domains.title: 情報・交渉と政治
domains.scope: 情報収集、外交・婚姻・人質、中央政治を通じて他者へ働きかける。

domains.title: 全国の世界と歴史
domains.scope: 全国地理・史実配置・開始条件と、歴史と自由行動の共存を整える。

domains.title: 共通の行動・操作と世界の稼働
domains.scope: 世界時間・任務・委任・NPC・画面・外見を、製品全体で使える形にする。

criteria: Village organization, members and rotating representative are separate from site and house; local proposals record refusal and representative version
Explicit confirmation and bounded relief/work promises preserve expiry, cancellation and existing obligations across representative change
Actual relief and water labor use the existing conserved rice and workforce accounts; partial delivery and reserved salary cannot be duplicated or bypassed
Dated fulfillment and breach affect next village reply without forced general loyalty or remote disclosure
Normal-entry consultation UI, real generation recovery and future equality, legacy v4 bytes, Game build and headless Node3D placement
target_meaning: Village representative consultation, relief/work performance and local reaction; not all factions, uprisings or national administration. One point is a minimum, not a stopping target.
